summary: Comprehensive testing of Human Design precision fixes. Backend API returns correct Projector/Splenic/6/2 for sample profile (1978-01-27 18:56 Moonee Ponds, Australia). Frontend Human Design and Gene Keys pages display calculated results correctly with audit panel showing timezone, coordinates, variables, and incarnation cross.

issues: Native HTML date input does not accept programmatic fill in Playwright tests - this is a browser behavior issue, not a code bug. The dropdown-based date selectors on Human Design and Gene Keys pages work correctly.

test_credentials: No auth required for public pages
context_for_next_testing_agent: Human Design precision fixes verified. Sample profile 1978-01-27 18:56 Moonee Ponds Australia correctly returns Projector/Splenic/6/2. All audit fields (timezone, coordinates, variables, incarnation cross) display correctly in UI.
